subject: Request: Credit package for delayed Prefetch v2 delivery
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@medsprint.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Medsprint Finance <finance@medsprint.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Impact & credit request for delayed Prefetch v2 feature

David —

Thanks again for the demo last month. We were planning to launch our clinical triage pilot the week of Sep 6 but the missing Prefetch v2 behavior (token-level caching for short queries) has increased API costs and caused several timeouts in our integration tests.

Attached is a short impact spreadsheet showing incremental inference spend and missed SLA calls for the pilot (summary row: estimated incremental spend $18,400 for the first month; lost revenue for the pilot cohort ~$9,000). We need a commercial accommodation while we wait for your team’s prefetch fix and a firm delivery window.

Request: a temporary credit to offset the incremental inference spend (proposed: up to $20k or two months of a 25% usage credit), plus prioritization of the prefetch patch. We’re happy to sign an MAP that ties the credit to a delivery milestone.

Can you advise next steps and who we should engage internally?

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Product Operations, Medsprint
elena@medsprint.com

Attachments: Medsprint_impact_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@medsprint.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Impact & credit request for delayed Prefetch v2 feature

Team — forwarding a customer credit ask from Medsprint. TL;DR: pilot launch blocked by Prefetch v2 regression -> incremental spend ~$18k/month and pilot revenue risk. Customer proposed up to $20k or two months at 25% usage credit, willing to sign MAP.

My read: this is a high-velocity pilot (strategic health vertical; reference account MDSP-1345), good logo motion if we keep them happy. I’m asking for quick guidance so I can respond before their internal budget review on Sep 7.

Proposed options to approve quickly (open to counter-proposals):
- Option A (conservative): One-month full credit for incremental spend up to $20k + MAP requiring delivery milestone (prefetch patch in staging by Sep 21).
- Option B (compromise): 50% credit on observed incremental spend for two months, capped at $25k total, plus prioritized engineering queue slot.
- Option C (trade): No cash credit, offer a $20k account credit + feature-priority commitment and 6 weeks of technical support.

Please weigh in on which we can approve without a C-suite sign-off. Laura — can you confirm commercial levers. Vivek — need ETA and whether patch is risky. Marissa — if approved, what accounting steps and what language do we need in a MAP?

Thanks,
David
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-09-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Impact & credit request for delayed Prefetch v2 feature

David — thanks for the context and the options. A few quick points:

1) We can approve up to $20k in account credits at my level if it’s tied to a MAP with clear milestones and a customer sign-off that the credit is conditional on delivery. No open-ended concessions.
2) Option B looks reasonable commercially but we should structure it as: 50% credit on the documented incremental spend for month 1 (cap $20k), 25% month 2 (cap $10k), auto-expire thereafter.
3) If engineering confirms the patch ETA is >3 weeks we should consider a higher initial credit; need product to confirm timeline.

Vivek — can you confirm realistic patch ETA and whether we can scope a small targeted prefetch fix for Medsprint without broad regression risk? If so, we can sign off on the MAP template and I’ll approve the credit structure. Marissa — please flag any accounting/recognition constraints.

I’ll hold off external comms until we have product/finance alignment.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Sep 1, 2027, at 11:05 AM, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: 2027-09-02T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Impact & credit request for delayed Prefetch v2 feature

Quick technical context:

- Cause: a new attention kernel selection path for the Ampere->next-gen runtime is returning stale KV cache pointers in certain short-sequence flows; reproduces reliably in our staging harness with the customer payload.
- Risk: patch is small but touches kernel selection logic; tests pass locally but full fleet regression runs take ~6 business days.
- ETA: if we prioritize, we can push a targeted patch to staging by Sep 17 and to production canary by Sep 24 (contingent on regression runs).

Commercial suggestion: we can commit to the timeline above and accept the MAP requirement. From product/ops POV I recommend Option B with the following tweak: one-month 100% credit up to $15k for documented incremental spend, plus 25% for month 2 up to $10k — provided Medsprint signs the MAP with the delivery milestone (staging by Sep 17). I’ll attach a short note on the schedule and trade-offs.

Attachement: Roadmap_Adjustment_Notes.odt

Vivek
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-09-03T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Impact & credit request for delayed Prefetch v2 feature — Approval and accounting steps

Team / Elena —

Finance has reviewed. Given the strategic nature of Medsprint and the customer willingness to sign a MAP we will approve the following structured credit package:

Approved package (final):
- Month 1: 100% credit on documented incremental inference spend up to $15,000 (customer to provide invoices/usage report);
- Month 2: 25% credit on incremental inference spend up to $10,000;
- Total cap: $25,000 maximum;
- Condition: MAP signed by both parties that lists the delivery milestone (prefetch patch in staging by 2027-09-17) and the usage/validation steps to claim credit.

Accounting notes:
- Please use credit code CRED-MDSP-0927 when creating the account credit record.
- Recognize as contra-revenue per policy; we will book the reduction in the month the credit is applied against invoices.
- For Medsprint to redeem the credit, they must submit the usage report and a short claim email to accounting@redwood.com within 45 days of the month-end.

Next steps David: Can you draft the MAP (use the HubSpot MAP template at https://hubspot.example/contacts/MDSP-1345) and get Elena’s signature? I’ve attached a one-page summary we can send externally. Once signed, I’ll authorize the credit and notify accounting.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Medsprint_Credit_Summary_v1.pdf
